jobs.occupation: Experienced Dairy Farm Worker Wanted for a Well-Managed Dairy Farm Near 9370 Hals
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a workplace where animal welfare and employee well-being go hand in hand?

For our client, a well-managed dairy farm near 9370 Hals, Denmark, we are looking for an experienced dairy farm worker to join the team. Start date can be arranged individually.

Behind the farm is a dedicated farmer who has spent the last 20 years building something special. The vision has always been clear: to run a farm with a strong focus on animal welfare while creating a workplace where employees feel valued, respected, and motivated to come to work every day.

The employer understands that people are different. Some thrive with fixed routines, while others prefer varied tasks. Some enjoy working many hours, while others value a healthy work-life balance. What matters most is that employees are seen, heard, and supported, because a successful farm is built by people who enjoy what they do.

That is why flexibility and open dialogue are an important part of everyday life on the farm.

About the Farm

• Approximately 380 dairy cows

• Modern dairy production

• 26-point rotary milking parlor

• Strong focus on animal welfare, quality, and teamwork

Your Responsibilities

• Milking cows

• Monitoring milking operations

• Maintaining high hygiene standards in the barn

• Contributing to excellent animal welfare

• Assisting with other tasks related to dairy production

We Are Looking for Someone Who

• Has experience working with dairy cattle

• Has knowledge of animal welfare and hygiene standards

• Is responsible, honest, and reliable

• Can work independently

• Speaks English

Working Hours

The current working schedule is:

• 03:00 – 08:00

• 15:00 – 19:00

On weekdays, employees generally work one shift per day, while weekends involve two daily shifts.

If the current milking schedule is not ideal for the right candidate, the employer is open to discussing possible adjustments to the working hours.

What the Employer Offers

• A workplace with a high degree of freedom and responsibility

• An employer who trusts their employees

• Opportunity to influence daily work routines

• Strong focus on employee well-being and job satisfaction

• Accommodation available

• Long-term employment with fair and stable working conditions

For this employer, professional skills are important, but personal qualities matter just as much. They are looking for someone who keeps their word, is honest, and wants to be part of a positive working environment.

jobs.occupation: Pig Farm Employee Wanted for Modern Pig Production in Denmark
jobs.description:
Are you interested in pig production and looking for a stable, long-term job in Denmark? We are looking for a motivated and reliable employee to join our team at a modern pig farm near Fjerritslev in North Jutland.

This is a permanent full-time position with the opportunity to become part of a professional and international team.

About the Farm

We operate a modern pig production with:

• 1,500 sows

• Approximately 50,000 finishing pigs annually

• A team of Danish and international employees

We offer a friendly working environment where teamwork, responsibility, and good animal care are highly valued.

Job Responsibilities

The position is primarily within the sow unit and includes:

• Breeding and gestation management

• Daily care of sows and piglets

• Piglet processing, including castration

• Moving pigs between sections

• Cleaning and washing barns (approximately once per week)

• General farm and production-related tasks

You should be able to work independently, but support from colleagues is always available.

We Are Looking For Someone Who

• Has an interest in pig production

• Enjoys working with animals

• Can work independently and take responsibility

• Is a positive team player

• Speaks English

• Holds a valid driver's licence

Experience from farming or livestock production is an advantage, but not a requirement. Experience with pig production or castration is considered a plus.

What We Offer

• Permanent employment

• Average of 37 working hours per week

• Work every second weekend

• Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience

• A supportive and international work environment

• Opportunity for long-term career development

Working Hours

Monday to Friday

• Earlier finish on Fridays when possible

Breaks

• Morning break: 09:00 - 09:30 (bread provided by the employer)

• Lunch break: 12:00 - 12:30

Accommodation

Accommodation is available on the farm within walking distance of the workplace.

Options include:

Rental terms and price will be agreed individually.

As soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Certified Welders Wanted – Permanent Positions in Denmark
jobs.description:
About Langkjær Staalbyg A/S

Langkjær Staalbyg A/S is an owner-managed company with 45 years of experience in the design, engineering, production and installation of structural steel constructions for both large and small building, construction and industrial projects.

Our headquarters are located in Vildbjerg, Denmark, where we carry out all activities related to engineering, production and surface treatment.

We are looking

We are looking for skilled and reliable welders with the following qualifications:

• MAG welding – Process 135. Additional certification in Processes 136/138 is an advantage.
• H-LO45 certification is preferred.
• Alternatively, a minimum qualification in fillet and butt welds on material thicknesses of 3 mm and above.
• Welding certificates for pipes from Ø30 mm are preferred.
We offer

• Permanent employment with attractive pay and working conditions under a Danish collective agreement.
• Hourly pay: EUR 26.50, including the 10% optional benefits allowance (Fritvalg).
• Additional 11% pension contribution.
• Possibility of a rotation scheme: 3 weeks working in Denmark followed by 1 week at home.
• Possibility of overtime, paid at an enhanced rate from the first hour.
• Assistance with finding accommodation.
Requirements

• Relevant welding experience and valid qualifications as described above.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• A professional and reliable approach to work.
• Good spoken English skills and the ability to communicate effectively in the workplace.
• Be a citizen of an EU/EEA country, or already hold a valid Danish work permit.
How to apply
Please send your application and CV to:
Email: job@staalbyg.dk

For questions regarding the position, please contact:
Martin Munk
Production Manager
Mobile: +45 20 80 24 25
